text:
alex_sales: Heads-up — ACME asked for a single POC org where they can run hosted API tests + a short Dedicated pool trial. They want clear spend caps, a daily alert if >50% of credits, and ephemeral keys for engineers. Who owns the billing project setup?

jamal_se: I can own the dedicated mapping + ephemeral keys. Quick plan: create a billing project for the POC, attach free credits (seed), set a hard spend cap at project level, then map the Dedicated tenant to that project for chargeback.

alex_sales: Sweet. Also they asked whether spend caps will block traffic or just stop billing and alert.

olivia_finops: We offer two behaviours: soft alert (notify at thresholds) and hard block (reject new requests once cap hit). For POCs we usually enable soft alerts plus an enforced daily hard cap on the seeded credits to avoid surprises. Recommend enabling "Budget Sentry" alerts at 50/75/90% and a hard-project cap at their approved credit amount.

natasha_infra: For the Dedicated pool mapping I need the tenant name & whether they want VPC/private deployment. If they require egress IP allowlist we need their ASN/IP blocks now. Without that we attach them to a shared test pool only.

alex_sales: They want both: start hosted API + ephemeral keys, then demo Dedicated with a single GPU pool. I'll collect egress IPs but likely they won't have static nat yet.

jamal_se: Implementation notes for the team (internal):
```
# create billing project (internal admin CLI)
rw-admin billing create-project --name "acme-poc-2026" --seed-credits 5000 --hard-cap 5000
# create ephemeral key that is scoped to the project and expires 24h
poc-keygen --project acme-poc-2026 --scope=read,write --ttl=24h --label "acme-eng-ephemeral"
# map dedicated tenant (once tenant exists)
rw-admin dedicated map-tenant --tenant acme-ded-01 --project acme-poc-2026
```

jamal_se: Ephemeral keys: they are bearer tokens that we mint scoped to a project. TTL max for POCs is 72h but default 24h. Keys inherit project-level spend caps so if project hits hard cap, requests with those keys will be rejected.

natasha_infra: On Dedicated: if they need Private/VPC we need to spin up a customer tenant (isolated) — that requires an enterprise onboarding ticket. For a quick demo we can use a reserved slice in our shared test pool but latency/placement will vary.

olivia_finops: Invoice flow: POCs on seeded credits don't get invoices until they opt into billed usage. If they exceed credits we either pause or bill based on the cap config agreed in the SOW. Make sure AE signs the POC spend amount into the order form if we want auto-billing.

alex_sales: Ok. Action items: (1) I will ask ACME for egress IPs and confirm dedicated demo window. (2) @jamal_se please provision billing project + seed credits and create one ephemeral key for the demo env. (3) @natasha_infra flag if we need tenant creation ticket.

jamal_se: Will do. Provis request queued — pinging billing-bot to generate request id.

billing-bot: Request received: REQ-2026-3314. Owner: jamal_se. ETA: ~2h for project + seed credits provisioning. React with :white_check_mark: when you have keys.

natasha_infra: If ACME can't provide egress IPs before the demo, we'll fallback to shared pool and note potential variability. I also need permission to create a dedicated tenant if they want private later — tagging infra lead for approval.

olivia_finops: I'll prepare a short one-pager for the AE explaining soft vs hard caps + invoice triggers so the customer gets the expectation.

alex_sales: Great — thanks team. I'll update ACME and post back the IPs and demo slot. :thumbsup:
